B Ancient Monuments Preservation Act, 1904: Wakf Act, 1954-Sections 4, 26 and 56 : c Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964-Sectbn 67: Acquisition of suit property by Government of India as ancient protected monument-Acquisition proved by documentary and ocular evidence-Inquiry .under Revenue Act and the Notification as invalid and D declaring Government as the owner by adverse possession-Suit decreed­ High Court affirmed the finding of trial Court holding that Government is owner even by adverse possession-On appeal, held: Suit property is Government property and not Wakf
